# Acceptable Use Policy

Policy ID: IT-SEC-004. Applies to all company devices and accounts. More guidance: <https://intranet.example.com/it/security>.

## Password Requirements

- Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.
  - Passphrases of four or more words are encouraged.
- Passwords must not be reused across the last 10 passwords.
- Password managers approved by IT may be used.
